headline: US set to complete military withdrawal from Iraq by September 30 under 2024 agreement

supports: The United States is set to complete the withdrawal of its remaining forces from Iraq by September 30, 2026.
The withdrawal follows a 2024 U.S.-Iraq agreement to wind down the U.S.-led coalition mission against Islamic State.
U.S. and Iraqi officials said U.S. military forces would leave Iraq by the end of September 2026.
The Pentagon said the departure reaffirmed the 2024 agreement with Iraq to end the coalition mission against Islamic State fighters.
